method: Incidence = pooled time-loss injuries / pooled exposure hours × 1,000.
Burden = pooled days lost / pooled exposure hours × 1,000.
Mean severity = pooled days lost / pooled time-loss injuries.
Match exposure = all registered fixtures × 15 players × 80 minutes / 60 per team.
Training exposure = total cleaned exposure minus match exposure.
IOC-aligned body-location and tissue/pathology categories use the accepted V2 mappings.

headline.label: Recorded injuries
headline.formula: count(eligible injury rows in each team coverage window)

headline.label: Time-loss injuries
headline.formula: count(eligible injury rows where days lost > 0)

headline.label: Incidence
headline.formula: pooled time-loss injuries / pooled exposure hours * 1000

headline.label: Mean severity
headline.formula: pooled days lost / pooled time-loss injuries

headline.label: Median severity
headline.formula: median(days lost) across pooled time-loss injuries

headline.label: Burden
headline.formula: pooled days lost / pooled exposure hours * 1000

limitations: Team coverage is not uniform; the pooled estimate retains each approved team-specific window.
Unknown-setting injuries are included in overall metrics but have no match/training rate.
Exact diagnoses are not inferred; injury profiles combine controlled IOC body and tissue/pathology categories.

prior_season.note: No prior-season league injury and exposure denominator pair has passed the V2 workflow.

analysis_window.basis: Pooled across 16 approved team-specific coverage windows; exact windows are retained in coverage.
